entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: One of the oldest and most powerful Jamuraan empires on Dominaria, a nation of traders led by a royal house.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Suq'Ata exists.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The huge continent where Suq'Ata is located.

entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: A plane some Suq'Ata founders came from, birthplace of the way of the assassin.

entities.name: Wildfire
entities.description: A plane some Suq'Ata founders came from.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Kingdom from which Suq'Ata annexed the northern Ekundu Mountains.

entities.name: Ekundu Mountains
entities.description: Mountains annexed by Suq'Ata, one of its natural borders.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War in which Suq'Ata sustained the least damage of the three kingdoms.

entities.name: Breathstealers
entities.description: Assassins from Urborg who infiltrated Suq'Atan society.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Leader of armies in the Mirage War.

entities.name: Qhattib
entities.description: Vizier of Amiqat, murdered by the Breathstealers.

entities.name: Telim'Tor
entities.description: A brute who succeeded the Pasha after Qhattib's murder.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased out most of Suq'Ata's territories.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Closed the Zhalfirin rift by force.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Suq'Ata's territories were phased out.

entities.name: Amiqat
entities.description: The capital of Suq'Ata, ruled by the Pasha and his vizier.

events.summary: Settlers from Wildfire and Rabiah arrive on Dominaria through planar portals and found Suq'Ata.
events.quote: Suq’Ata was founded by people from the planes of Wildfire and Rabiah

events.summary: Suq'Ata annexes the northern Ekundu Mountains from Femeref.
events.quote: They annexed the northern Ekundu Mountains from Femeref

events.summary: During the Mirage War the Breathstealers infiltrate Suq'Atan society and murder Qhattib, letting Telim'Tor succeed the Pasha.
events.quote: This was made manifest by the murder of Qhattib

events.summary: Teferi phases out most of Suq'Ata's territories during the Phyrexian Invasion; they are lost forever after Jeska closes the rift.
events.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion Teferi planeswalker phased out most of Suq'Ata's territorities.

relations.quote: one of the oldest and most powerful of the Jamuraan empires on Dominaria

relations.note: Vizier to the Pasha of Amiqat.
relations.quote: It was ruled by the Pasha of Suq'ata and his vizier Qhattib

relations.note: Implied by the murder of Qhattib during their infiltration.
